items.description: A friendly empty, no-results or error placeholder with 5 icon presets, a floating icon tile, title, description and actions, in plain, card and dashed styles with a staggered entrance.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: A multi-value input that turns text into removable tags on Enter, comma or paste, with suggestions, duplicate and max limits, custom validation and an animated add and remove.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable select where you type to filter options, with match highlighting, option descriptions, disabled options, a clear button, an empty state and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: A searchable multi-select that shows the chosen options as removable chips, with checkbox rows, select all, a selection limit, a +N overflow chip, an empty state and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A date picker with a popover calendar: single date or range selection, month navigation, min/max and disabled dates, Today and Clear shortcuts, localized labels and full keyboard support.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: A time picker with a popover of scrollable hour, minute and AM/PM columns: 12 or 24-hour clock, minute steps, min/max times, a Now shortcut and full keyboard support.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time-code input with individual animated cells, paste and autofill support, numeric or alphanumeric mode, masking, grouped cells, error shake and success states.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: A numeric field with minus/plus steppers, press-and-hold auto repeat, min/max clamping, decimal precision, prefix and suffix, thousand separators and full keyboard support.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with an animated show/hide eye toggle, a four-segment strength meter, a live requirements checklist and a Caps Lock warning.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input
items.description: A phone number input with a searchable country menu: flags and calling codes, as-you-type formatting per country, paste detection for +codes, an E.164 value and a length check.

items.name: credit-card-input
items.title: Credit Card Input
items.description: A grouped card number, expiry and CVC field: brand detection with an animated mark, 4-4-4-4 or Amex 4-6-5 spacing, Luhn and expiry checks, and focus that moves on as each part is complete.

items.name: currency-input
items.title: Currency Input
items.description: A money input with a currency picker: live thousands separators for any locale, the right number of decimals per currency, an animated symbol, arrow-key steps and min/max, returning a plain number.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A compact radio-style switch between a few options with a sliding animated thumb, solid or soft styles, icons, icon-only mode, vertical orientation and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A color picker with a draggable saturation/brightness area, hue and opacity sliders, hex input, preset swatches and an optional screen eyedropper, all keyboard accessible.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A drag-and-drop file dropzone with click-to-browse, type/size/count validation, image previews, animated progress bars, retry and remove actions.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature Pad
items.description: A signature field that draws smooth, pressure-aware ink, with undo, clear, a typed-signature option for people who can't draw, and PNG and SVG export in a paper-ready ink colour.

items.name: image-cropper
items.title: Image Cropper
items.description: An image cropper with a draggable, resizable crop box, aspect presets or a circle mask for avatars, keyboard nudging, drag-and-drop upload and the cropped image returned as a data URL.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: An inline message block with info, success, warning, danger and neutral variants, three appearances, self-drawing icons, an optional action link and an animated dismiss.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A meter for a value within a known range: bar, semicircle gauge or segmented variants with threshold zones, animated counting numbers and proper meter semantics.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: A Cmd/Ctrl+K command palette with fuzzy search and match highlighting, grouped results, keyboard navigation, shortcuts and a portal overlay.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A desktop-style app menubar with File/Edit/View-style dropdown menus, checkbox and radio items, submenus and full arrow-key navigation between and within menus.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A collapsible app sidebar with grouped nav sections, a sliding active-item indicator, badges, an icon-only rail mode with hover tooltips, a user footer and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A macOS-style app dock with cursor-proximity magnification, running-app indicator dots, hover tooltips, separators and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: A focused alert dialog for confirming an action, with default/warning/danger variants, an async-aware confirm button with a spinner and inline error, and a safety-first default focus.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A hover-triggered rich preview card with open/close delays, a hover bridge so moving into the card keeps it open, placement with collision flip, an optional arrow and keyboard support.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click context menu with checkbox and radio items, nested submenus, viewport edge clamping and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A vertical timeline with status markers (done, active, pending, error), a connecting line, an alternating layout option, collapsible per-item detail and a scroll-triggered staggered reveal.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree View
items.description: A hierarchical tree with expand/collapse, tri-state checkboxes for multi-select, single-row selection, guide lines and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: A dashboard metric card with an animated count-up value, an auto-derived good/bad trend badge, an optional icon and a drawn-in sparkline.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A syntax-highlighted code block with line numbers, per-line highlighting, a filename/language header, a copy button and a collapsible fade-out for long snippets.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description List
items.description: A semantic term/value list for specs, order summaries or profile details, with stacked, inline and grid layouts, optional icons and a hover-reveal copy button per row.

items.name: splitter
items.title: Splitter
items.description: Resizable panels divided by draggable handles, with min/max size constraints, keyboard resizing, double-click reset, and horizontal or vertical layout.

items.name: back-to-top
items.title: Back to Top
items.description: A floating scroll-to-top button that fades in past a threshold, with an optional progress ring showing how far down the page you are.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: A standalone copy-to-clipboard button with ghost/outline/solid variants, icon-only or labeled modes, a floating tooltip, and animated copied/error states.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A macOS-style terminal window that types out a scripted sequence of commands, outputs and comments, with a blinking cursor, auto-scroll and optional looping or manual replay.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline Edit
items.description: Click-to-edit text that turns into an auto-sizing input with save/cancel controls, validation, async save support and a shake on error.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: A container that locks its content to a fixed width/height ratio (a preset like video or square, or a custom number), auto-fitting a single image or video child.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrollable container with a thin, draggable, auto-hiding custom scrollbar (vertical, horizontal or both) and edge fade masks, replacing the native browser scrollbar.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: An accessible toolbar of icon buttons, toggles, radio-style toggle groups and separators with roving-focus arrow-key navigation, a sliding hover highlight and animated tooltips.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: A surface container with an optional header (icon, title, description, actions), body and footer, with outline, filled and elevated variants and an animated collapse.

items.name: your-cart-page
items.title: Your Cart Page
items.description: A three-step eCommerce flow in one block: a cart with quantity steppers and promo code, a checkout form with an order summary, and an animated order-confirmed screen.

items.name: stat-feature
items.title: Stat Feature
items.description: A metrics section with a concentric ring chart, a trend caption and count-up stats that enter with a blur, slide, fade or scale animation.

items.name: product-list
items.title: Product List
items.description: An eCommerce product listing block with a filter sidebar (live search, Free/Premium tiers, categories) and a responsive photo grid with New and Sale badges.

items.name: product-detail
items.title: Product Detail
items.description: An eCommerce product page block with a switchable image gallery, color and size pickers, quantity stepper, animated add-to-cart button and Description / Specs / Reviews tabs.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: An accessible button with primary, secondary, outline, and ghost variants, a spinning loading state, optional icon, and a focus ring, every color, size, and timing exposed as a prop.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: An accessible text input with outline, filled, and underline variants, label/helper/error text, a password show/hide toggle, and a focus ring, every color, size, and timing exposed as a prop.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: An accessible textarea with outline, filled, and underline variants, label/helper/error text, optional auto-resize and a character counter, and a focus ring, every color, size, and timing exposed as a prop.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form Field
items.description: A form field wrapper with label, description, required or optional marker, info tooltip, character counter and animated helper, error and success messages, with sync or async validation and aria wiring for any control.

items.name: rich-text-editor
items.title: Rich Text Editor
items.description: A rich text editor with a formatting toolbar, headings, lists, quotes, inline code and links, Markdown-style shortcuts, clean pasting from Docs and Word, and a word count, with no editor library.

items.name: sales-ticket-popup
items.title: Sales Ticket Popup
items.description: A corner-anchored promo popup shaped like a torn event ticket, with 5 themes, a zigzag badge stub, immediate/delay/scroll triggers, auto-hide, and dismiss-memory.

items.name: expand-card-grid
items.title: Expand Card Grid
items.description: A 2x2 grid of image cards that expand to fill the frame on click, revealing title/description/CTA, with keyboard arrow navigation between cards and swipe-to-close on touch.

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: A drag-and-drop task board with a hand-rolled pointer-based drag engine, velocity tilt, edge autoscroll, ghost drop-position indicator, priority badges, avatar stacks, and light/dark theming.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: An admin data table with sortable/filterable columns, global search, status tabs, row selection, badge/avatar/actions cell types, pagination, and light/dark/custom theming.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: A multi-series line/area chart, smooth Catmull-Rom curves, a highlighted zone band, a reference line, endpoint value badges, and a hover crosshair with per-series tooltips.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: A stacked bar chart, up to 5 series per bar, a reference line, a peak-value annotation, and a hover tooltip breaking down each bar's segments with a running total.

items.name: tearable-reveal
items.title: Tearable Reveal
items.description: A physically-simulated cloth intro reveal, drag to tear open a torn-paper layer covering an image, with breakable constraints, particle debris, frayed jagged/rounded edges, and optional surface text or logo. Includes Auto Tear and Reset controls.

items.name: desktop-mockup-carousel
items.title: Desktop Mockup Carousel
items.description: A realistic Studio Display-style monitor mockup with an internal video/image carousel, swipe or auto-advance, slide/fade transitions, 3D cursor tilt, ambient glow, and a progress bar.

items.name: range-area-chart
items.title: Range Area Chart
items.description: A min/max envelope chart with a nested core-range band, an actual-to-forecast line split, annotated risk zones, a reference line, and a live endpoint badge.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: A multi-series radar/spider chart with ring gridlines, per-series solid or dashed strokes, optional point markers, and a hover tooltip comparing every series at the highlighted axis.

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Pie Chart
items.description: A donut-style pie chart with a live center total, click-to-toggle legend, percentage callouts around the ring, and a hover tooltip with ARR, account count, and average contract size.

items.name: stacked-area-chart
items.title: Stacked Area Chart
items.description: A stacked area chart for totals and their parts: smooth layered areas that draw in on scroll, a Total / Share switch for a 100% view, legend toggles that reflow the stack, and a crosshair tooltip with every series and the total.

items.name: combo-chart
items.title: Combo Chart
items.description: A bar and line combo chart on two axes: bars for an amount like revenue, a smooth line for a rate like margin, with a dashed target, bars that grow in one after another, a line that draws over them, and a column tooltip with the change from the month before.

items.name: scatter-plot
items.title: Scatter Plot
items.description: A scatter plot for spotting relationships: coloured groups of points that pop in on scroll, a least-squares trend line with its slope and R², legend toggles, and a nearest-point tooltip with guide lines and value pills on both axes.

items.name: bubble-chart
items.title: Bubble Chart
items.description: A bubble chart for three measures at once: x, y and bubble size, coloured by group, split into four labelled quadrants like a portfolio matrix, with bubbles that pop in largest first, names inside the big ones and a tooltip that says which quadrant an item sits in.

items.name: candlestick-chart
items.title: Candlestick Chart
items.description: A trading-style candlestick chart: OHLC candles with a volume panel, a moving average, 1M / 3M / 6M range tabs, a last-price marker, and a crosshair with price and date pills plus a live OHLC readout.

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel Chart
items.description: A conversion funnel as one smooth flowing shape: each step's width follows its count, curving into the next, with step-to-step conversion pills on the joins, ghost bands that show how much was lost, a drop-off tooltip and a stacked-rows layout on phones.

items.name: waterfall-chart
items.title: Waterfall Chart
items.description: A waterfall (bridge) chart that explains how a number got from A to B: floating bars for each increase and decrease, totals anchored to zero, dashed connectors, signed value labels, a net change in the header and a running-total tooltip.

items.name: treemap-chart
items.title: Treemap Chart
items.description: A squarified treemap of a two-level hierarchy: tile area follows value, tiles are coloured by growth from red through neutral to green, groups carry labelled headers, and clicking a group zooms into it with tiles gliding to their new places.

items.name: sankey-diagram
items.title: Sankey Diagram
items.description: A Sankey diagram of how things flow between stages: columns of nodes sized by volume, gradient ribbons whose thickness follows each flow, a layout that untangles crossings, hover highlighting of a node's paths and a tooltip with both shares.

items.name: contribution-heatmap
items.title: Contribution Heatmap
items.description: A year-long activity calendar in the style of a contribution graph: one square per day in week columns, five colour levels from quartiles, month and weekday labels, longest and current streaks, a best-day stat, day tooltips and a grid that fits any width.

items.name: radial-bar-chart
items.title: Radial Bar Chart
items.description: A radial bar chart laid out like a clock: rounded bars radiate from a centre ring for each hour, coloured from quiet to busy, with faint outlines for last week, a centre readout that follows the hovered hour and stat tiles for the peak and quietest times.

items.name: streamgraph
items.title: Streamgraph
items.description: A streamgraph of how a mix shifts over time: smooth streams flowing around a moving centre line, each swelling and thinning with its share, named inside where they're thick, with hover highlighting and a sorted weekly breakdown.

items.name: bullet-chart
items.title: Bullet Chart
items.description: A bullet chart for goals: one compact row per KPI with poor / fair / good bands, the actual value as a bar, a target line, last quarter's marker and an on-track / at-risk / behind status, including metrics where lower is better.

items.name: realtime-line-chart
items.title: Realtime Line Chart
items.description: A live streaming line chart: a new reading every second glides in from the right, the scale eases to fit, readings over the alert threshold turn the line red, and a pulsing live badge, pause button and current / average / peak / alerts stats sit above it.

items.name: neon-pulse-line-chart
items.title: Neon Pulse Line Chart
items.description: A calm line with a bright pulse travelling along it, lighting up a row of heat cells as it passes. Three stats, a one-line readout and keyboard day inspection.

items.name: marching-ants-line-chart
items.title: Marching Ants Line Chart
items.description: A line chart you measure by dragging: the range gets a marching ants outline, the stats follow it, and the forecast part of the line marches too.

items.name: ghost-trail-line-chart
items.title: Ghost Trail Line Chart
items.description: Compare periods by flipping through them: the line swings to its new shape and leaves fading ghosts behind, with earlier periods kept as faint traces.

items.name: forecast-ribbon-chart
items.title: Forecast Ribbon Chart
items.description: A forecast that shows its doubt: history runs into nested 50, 80 and 95% ribbons that widen with time, and scenarios ease from one shape to the next.

items.name: barcode-bar-chart
items.title: Barcode Bar Chart
items.description: A week of hours as a barcode: one thin line per hour, brighter when busier. A lens opens under the pointer, and the lines can rise into a regular bar chart.

items.name: liquid-fill-bar-chart
items.title: Liquid Fill Bar Chart
items.description: Usage limits as bars of liquid: gentle waves on every surface, levels that spring to new values with a slosh, and a warning line near the top.

items.name: lollipop-ranking-chart
items.title: Lollipop Ranking Chart
items.description: A ranked list of thin lollipops that reorders itself: switch period and the rows glide to their new places, with each one showing how far it climbed or fell.

items.name: diverging-sentiment-chart
items.title: Diverging Sentiment Chart
items.description: Five-point survey results around a zero line: negative opens left, positive opens right, neutral sits across the middle, and topics sort themselves by net score.

items.name: orbit-radial-chart
items.title: Orbit Radial Chart
items.description: Goals as concentric orbits: each ring closes as its target is met, a small satellite circles every track, and pointing at a ring brings its number to the centre.

items.name: spiral-progress-chart
items.title: Spiral Progress Chart
items.description: A long project as one spiral path: progress winds out from the centre, milestones sit along the way, and a second marker shows where the plan says you should be.

items.name: petal-radar-chart
items.title: Petal Radar Chart
items.description: A radar chart that blooms: each score is a petal, a dashed outline shows the benchmark, and petals ease to their new size as you switch between teams.

items.name: constellation-scatter-plot
items.title: Constellation Scatter Plot
items.description: A scatter plot drawn as a night sky: points twinkle, each segment is joined into a constellation, and pointing at a star lights up its whole group.

items.name: gravity-bubble-chart
items.title: Gravity Bubble Chart
items.description: A force-based bubble chart with pointer attraction, collision separation, together/team layouts and keyboard-accessible project values.

items.name: ribbon-flow-sankey-chart
items.title: Ribbon Flow Sankey Chart
items.description: A Sankey chart with flowing ribbon textures, animated period comparisons, linked node highlighting and a shared scale across views.

items.name: calendar-pulse-heatmap
items.title: Calendar Pulse Heatmap
items.description: A year of activity in twelve dot calendars, with intensity levels, day-by-day replay, hover ripples and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: correlation-matrix-chart
items.title: Correlation Matrix Chart
items.description: An interactive Pearson correlation matrix with pairwise missing-data handling, a diverging color scale, strong-link emphasis and keyboard cell inspection.

items.name: ridgeline-density-chart
items.title: Ridgeline Density Chart
items.description: Layered Gaussian density estimates on a shared scale, with adjustable smoothing, region inspection, sample counts and median/90th-percentile readouts.

items.name: revenue-bridge-chart
items.title: Revenue Bridge Chart
items.description: A revenue waterfall that derives closing MRR from an opening balance and signed movements, with period comparisons, connectors and accessible balance inspection.

items.name: logo-marquee
items.title: Logo Marquee
items.description: An infinite scrolling row of client/partner logos with edge fade masks, grayscale-to-color hover reveal, pause-on-hover, and a constant speed regardless of logo count.

items.name: parallax-section
items.title: Parallax Section
items.description: A section of floating photos and type that drift at different speeds as it scrolls past, so the layers separate into depth, and lean slightly toward the pointer; works with page scrolling and scroll containers alike.

items.name: scroll-snap-sections
items.title: Scroll Snap Sections
items.description: Full-height sections that snap into place one at a time as you scroll, each sliding its eyebrow, title and text up while its photo unclips and settles, with a counter, a progress line and dot navigation.

items.name: entrance-reveal
items.title: Entrance Reveal
items.description: A wrapper that reveals its content as it scrolls into view: children (or the words of a heading) appear one after another, rising from behind a mask, fading up, sharpening out of a blur, scaling or sliding in, once or every time.

items.name: image-mask-reveal
items.title: Image Mask Reveal
items.description: An image that unveils itself through a moving mask — a circle opening from where the pointer came in, falling blinds, a cascade of tiles, a diagonal wipe or a parting curtain — on hover or as it scrolls into view, settling from a slight zoom.

items.name: click-burst
items.title: Click Burst
items.description: A wrapper that makes anything celebrate a click: sparks, confetti, hearts, expanding rings or stars burst from the exact point you clicked, drawn on a canvas that spills past the element's edges and stops when the last particle fades.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: A button that's pulled toward the pointer as it comes near, with its label drifting a little further for depth, a fill that sweeps in from the side you entered, and a springy wobble back into place when you move away.

items.name: orbiting-border-glow
items.title: Orbiting Border Glow
items.description: A border that a beam of light runs around: a bright conic streak orbits the edge of any card, button or badge, a soft halo of the same light spills outside it, and the beam picks up speed smoothly while you hover.

items.name: target-lock-cursor
items.title: Target Lock Cursor
items.description: A custom cursor of four corner brackets that roams freely, then snaps around whatever you point at — links, buttons or anything marked data-lock — resizing to its exact bounds with a quick focus squeeze and a label tag, like a camera locking on.

items.name: fluid-ink-cursor
items.title: Fluid Ink Cursor
items.description: A background where the pointer paints with ink: drops pool along your path, merge into one another, blend between colours like marbled paper, bleed into the paper's grain at the edges, and slowly spread and fade away.

items.name: photo-trail-cursor
items.title: Photo Trail Cursor
items.description: An area where moving the pointer deals out photos along its path: each one pops in turned the way you were travelling, holds for a moment on top of the last, then sinks and fades, cycling through your set.

items.name: pixel-dissolve-transition
items.title: Pixel Dissolve Transition
items.description: A slideshow that changes images block by block: the frame breaks into a grid, each block flashes to the new picture's colour and then resolves into it, in a random scatter, a diagonal sweep or a ripple from the centre, with dots, arrows and autoplay.

items.name: edge-fade-blur
items.title: Edge Fade Blur
items.description: A scroll area whose content melts away at the edges: a stack of backdrop blurs ramps up smoothly toward the top and bottom while the content fades out, and each edge only appears when there's more to scroll that way.

items.name: peel-off-sticker
items.title: Peel-off Sticker
items.description: A sticker you can actually peel: grab a corner and it lifts along a fold that follows your pointer, showing the paper backing in the sticker's own shape with a soft shadow; let go and it settles back, or pull far enough and it comes off and sticks itself back on.

items.name: chrome-liquid-logo
items.title: Chrome Liquid Logo
items.description: Your word or logotype cast in liquid chrome: the letters puff up like inflated metal, reflect a bright studio with a crisp horizon, ripple as liquid flows across them and around the pointer, in silver, gold, copper or any tint.

items.name: magnetic-field-lines
items.title: Magnetic Field Lines
items.description: A field of iron filings that line up around a magnet you move: hundreds of short strokes swing round to follow a real dipole field, curving into the classic loops, glowing warm on the north side and cool on the south, and a click flips the poles.

items.name: gooey-blob-merge
items.title: Gooey Blob Merge
items.description: Glossy liquid blobs that drift, stretch and fuse together like lava-lamp goo: your pointer becomes a blob of its own that pulls them into one shape, trails a drop behind it, and a click flicks off a little droplet.

items.name: cursor-ribbons
items.title: Cursor Ribbons
items.description: Silky, tapered ribbons of colour that chase the pointer on springs of different stiffness, fanning apart when you move fast and gathering when you slow down, glowing where they cross and wandering on their own when idle.

items.name: reactive-cube-grid
items.title: Reactive Cube Grid
items.description: An isometric field of cubes that rises under the pointer like a pin-art toy: cubes spring up, overshoot and settle, glow in an accent colour as they climb, and a click sends a ring-shaped wave rolling out across the grid.

items.name: dot-screen-reveal
items.title: Dot Screen Reveal
items.description: A photo printed as a halftone dot screen that develops into the real image under your pointer: dots swell into each other and melt away in a soft window that follows the cursor, then the screen slowly grows back behind it.

items.name: liquid-text
items.title: Liquid Text
items.description: Text distorted through an animated SVG noise filter, 5 presets (liquid, melt, blob, ghost, crystal), cursor-proximity intensity, and a click burst ripple.

items.name: word-reveal
items.title: Word Reveal
items.description: Staggered word or character reveal text, driven by scroll progress, viewport entry, or a manual trigger, 4 animation presets, 3 stagger patterns, and word highlighting.

items.name: animated-heading
items.title: Animated Heading
items.description: A heading whose words arrive one after another, rising from a mask, sharpening from a blur or sliding in, as it scrolls into view or on hover.

items.name: text-stroke
items.title: Text Stroke / Outline Text
items.description: Big outlined lettering with fading echoes stacked beneath it, and a solid fill that follows the pointer through the word.

items.name: text-on-path
items.title: Text on Path
items.description: Words that flow along a wave, an arc or a circle, looping without a seam and scaling with their container.

items.name: word-rotator
items.title: Word Rotator
items.description: A headline with one word that keeps changing: each word rolls in while the space around it eases to fit, so the sentence never jumps.

items.name: typewriter-text
items.title: Typewriter Text
items.description: Text that types and deletes itself with a human, uneven beat, while the space it needs stays reserved so nothing around it moves.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer Text
items.description: A soft band of light that sweeps through a line of text, for loading states, AI status lines and quiet emphasis.

items.name: color-sweep-heading
items.title: Color Sweep Heading
items.description: A dimmed heading that fills with a colour gradient from left to right as it comes into view, and follows the pointer back and forth.

items.name: signal-glitch-title
items.title: Signal Glitch Title
items.description: A title that loses signal for a moment: colour channels split and slices of the word jump sideways in short bursts, then it snaps back clean.

items.name: gravity-letters
items.title: Gravity Letters
items.description: Brush a letter and it falls: letters drop with real gravity, bounce on the floor, then climb back to spell the word again.

items.name: focus-sweep-text
items.title: Focus Sweep Text
items.description: A paragraph with a moving point of focus: a few words stay sharp while the rest soften into blur, drifting along by itself or following the pointer.

items.name: velocity-marquee-text
items.title: Velocity Marquee Text
items.description: Oversized marquee rows that answer to your scrolling: they speed up and lean into it, then ease back to a steady drift.

items.name: proximity-weight-text
items.title: Proximity Weight Text
items.description: Letters that thicken and lift as the pointer gets near, in a soft wave that travels with it, without pushing the rest of the line around.

items.name: ascii-art-title
items.title: ASCII Art Title
items.description: Any word rebuilt from plain text characters, with a slow shimmer across its surface and ripples that spread from the pointer.

items.name: flip-board-text
items.title: Flip Board Text
items.description: A split-flap departure board: each cell clatters through the alphabet to its letter, one after another, whenever the message changes.

items.name: curved-text-marquee
items.title: Curved Text Marquee
items.description: A marquee on a bendy line: text runs along a curve that sags at rest, and the pointer pulls the whole band up or down.

items.name: extruded-depth-text
items.title: Extruded Depth Text
items.description: Letters with a solid 3D block behind them that leans away from the pointer, or turns slowly by itself, built entirely from text shadows.

items.name: paper-fold-heading
items.title: Paper Fold Heading
items.description: A heading folded like a concertina of paper. It opens as it comes into view, and folds back up while the pointer is over it.

items.name: odometer-counter
items.title: Odometer Counter
items.description: A number that rolls like a car odometer: each digit turns on its own column with a small delay, and separators and currency come from the locale.

items.name: alert-toast
items.title: Alert Toast
items.description: A polished toast/alert notification, 5 tones, stacked or inline layout, icons, primary/secondary actions, dismiss and auto-dismiss, light/dark theme, plus a showcase mode rendering every variant side by side.

items.name: flip-box
items.title: Flip Box
items.description: A photo card that turns over in 3D to show its details, flipping away from whichever edge the pointer came in from, with a priced feature list and call to action on the back, tap and keyboard support and a reduced-motion fallback.

items.name: image-box
items.title: Image Box
items.description: An image box for stories, projects and services in three layouts (stacked, overlay, split), with an image that drifts toward the pointer, a drawn title underline, a sliding arrow, a description that opens on hover in the overlay layout and the whole card as one accessible link.

items.name: pixelate-hover-card
items.title: Pixelate Hover Card
items.description: A photo card that breaks into a chunky pixel mosaic on hover and resolves into a second photo, or comes into focus from pixels, drawn on a canvas in stepped block sizes with a live pixel-size readout, touch and keyboard support and a reduced-motion crossfade.

items.name: card-shuffle-stack
items.title: Card Shuffle Stack
items.description: A loose pile of photo cards you shuffle through: throw the top card aside and it tucks in under the stack, bring the bottom one back on top, with drag and flick physics, buttons, arrow keys, optional autoplay and a reduced-motion fallback.

items.name: distorted-photo-card
items.title: Distorted Photo Card
items.description: A photo card with a liquid WebGL lens that follows the pointer: the image swells under it, ripples outward, smears and splits into RGB when you move fast, with a hairline ring tracking the lens, lazy WebGL setup and a plain-image fallback.

items.name: bouncing-card-fan
items.title: Bouncing Card Fan
items.description: A squared-up deck of photo cards that springs open into a fan on hover with a bouncy, centre-out stagger; the card under the pointer rises and nudges its neighbours aside, a click pops one up as the pick, and it opens with a tap on touch screens.

items.name: swinging-id-badge
items.title: Swinging ID Badge
items.description: An event ID badge hanging from a printed lanyard that you can grab and fling: it swings back on real pendulum physics, the strap stretches and settles, the card turns on its clip and the foil strip shimmers as it moves; click to turn it over to a QR code and access zones.

items.name: frosted-app-icons
items.title: Frosted App Icons
items.description: A home-screen card of frosted-glass app icons over drifting colour: a soft light follows the pointer behind the glass, icons lift with a specular highlight that tracks the cursor, opening an app ripples it and pops its unread badge, and a frosted dock sits underneath.

items.name: document-folder-stack
items.title: Document Folder Stack
items.description: A tabbed folder that opens when you point at it: the front flap hinges forward in 3D and the documents inside rise and fan out one after another, each with a file-type tag, title and meta line; click a document to lift it to the front.

items.name: color-reveal-grid
items.title: Color Reveal Grid
items.description: A grid of black-and-white photos where colour floods in from the exact point the pointer enters a tile, a little colour seeps into the neighbouring tiles, and it drains back out toward where the pointer leaves; captions slide up over each revealed photo.

items.name: product-grid-section
items.title: Product Grid Section
items.description: A responsive product/portfolio grid section, heading, per-card image with hover zoom and reveal overlay, category/price meta row, optional badge, and a centered CTA button below the grid.

items.name: ai-asistant
items.title: AI Asistant
items.description: A dotted status light with two layouts, Mesh grid and Halo rings, across three animated states (Waiting, Listening, Thinking), in four dot shapes with adjustable colors.

items.name: ai-voice-01
items.title: AI Voice 01
items.description: A voice-assistant pill with a canvas audio-reactive visualizer, idle/listening/speaking states, a glowing edge ring, live word-by-word transcript, optional real microphone input, and custom/silver themes.

items.name: ai-voice-05
items.title: AI Voice 05
items.description: A portrait voice-assistant card with a canvas audio-reactive curve visualizer, a mic button that grows on tap, idle/listening/speaking states, and live word-by-word transcript.

items.name: ai-image-loader-03
items.title: AI Image Loader 03
items.description: An AI image-generation loader, canvas-drawn rolling topographic lines grow in and a top-to-bottom sweep reveals the finished picture, with cycling status messages and a regenerate button.

items.name: ai-dynamic-island-01
items.title: AI Dynamic Island 01
items.description: A Dynamic Island-style AI status pill that morphs between idle, listening, thinking, working (with an unfolding step list) and done states, with a canvas-drawn particle orb and rippling energy curves.

items.name: ai-answer-03
items.title: AI Answer 03
items.description: An agent-style AI answer card, a researching/reading/writing step tracker with a progress rail, markdown-style bold and bullet text, clickable inline citations, source cards, follow-up questions, and custom/sunset themes.

items.name: ai-edit-review
items.title: AI Edit Review
items.description: An AI text editor that rewrites a selected passage, streams a word-level diff review with accept/reject actions, and morphs a dock through writing, review, and applied states.

items.name: video-glow-lightbox
items.title: Video Glow Lightbox
items.description: A single video card with a pulsing glow-blob frame that morphs into a fullscreen lightbox on click, supports direct URL, YouTube, Vimeo, or uploaded files, a cursor-following watch label, hover preview loop, and a Web Audio sound-reactive glow.

items.name: glide-carousel
items.title: Glide Carousel
items.description: A canvas-rendered, drag-to-scroll carousel with a curved wave layout and ambient wind/drift/magnetic card sway, click-to-open lightbox modal, autoplay, and image/video support.

items.name: testimonial-logos
items.title: Testimonial Logos
items.description: A compact trust bar, a star rating with a helped-N-teams label above an infinite, edge-masked logo marquee.

items.name: dice-discount-popup
items.title: Dice Discount Popup
items.description: A gamified discount popup, roll two animated 3D dice for a reward tier (with a doubles bonus), copy the code, and track rolls left across a session. Inline or corner-widget popup with manual, delay or scroll triggers.

items.name: scratch-card-popup
items.title: Scratch Card Popup
items.description: A gamified scratch-to-win popup, drag to scratch a gold-foil canvas off a 3x3 icon grid, match three to win a reward tier with a confetti burst, copy the code, and track attempts left. Inline or corner-widget popup with manual, delay or scroll triggers.

items.name: business-hours
items.title: Business Hours
items.description: A premium opening-hours card, live open/closed status with a pulsing dot, a day-by-day schedule, and a Get Directions link built from an address or custom URL.

items.name: google-maps-embed
items.title: Google Maps Embed
items.description: A Google Maps embed for one or more locations, with no API key needed: a hairline location list that crossfades the map, map/satellite and zoom controls, a darkened map for dark themes, directions and copy-address actions, live local time and an optional click-to-load consent screen.

items.name: motion-gallery-grid
items.title: Motion Gallery Grid
items.description: A perfectly aligned image grid with a centered glassmorphism overlay card, heading, subtitle and CTA button, with a staggered blur/slide/fade/scale entrance triggered on scroll into view.

items.name: qr-code-widget
items.title: QR Code Widget
items.description: A QR-code card, title, description, code image, hint text and an open-link button, inline or as a corner-widget popup with a focus-trapped modal dialog.

items.name: airbnb-reviews
items.title: Airbnb Reviews
items.description: A guest-review carousel with the Airbnb Bélo mark, aggregate rating header and CTA, above a draggable autoplaying grid of review cards.

items.name: ebay-reviews
items.title: eBay Reviews
items.description: A seller-feedback carousel with the eBay wordmark, aggregate rating header and CTA, above a draggable autoplaying grid of review cards.

items.name: etsy-reviews
items.title: Etsy Reviews
items.description: A shop-review carousel with the Etsy wordmark, aggregate rating header and CTA, above a draggable autoplaying grid of review cards.

items.name: coin-flip-game
items.title: Coin Flip Game
items.description: A real 3D CSS coin, click or tap to flip with a physical spin animation, a yes/no question field, flip history dots, and a heads/tails ratio readout.

items.name: tic-tac-toe-game
items.title: Tic Tac Toe Game
items.description: A playable Tic Tac Toe board with a built-in AI opponent, animated piece placement, a drawn winning-line reveal, score tracking, and a confetti burst on a win.

items.name: 2048-game
items.title: 2048 Game
items.description: A fully playable 2048, arrow-key and swipe controls, spring-animated tile merges, score and best-score tracking, and win/game-over overlays.

items.name: snake-game
items.title: Snake Game
items.description: A canvas-rendered Snake game with three difficulty speeds, keyboard and swipe controls, a directional-eyes snake head, high-score tracking, and ready/game-over overlays.

items.name: minesweeper-game
items.title: Minesweeper Game
items.description: A classic Minesweeper with three board sizes, flood-fill reveal, right-click flagging, a live mine counter and timer, and a confetti burst on a win.

items.name: memory-match-game
items.title: Memory Match Game
items.description: A flip-card memory matching game with animal emoji, three difficulty levels, a 3D flip animation, move/score tracking, and a win overlay.

items.name: pong-game
items.title: Pong Game
items.description: A canvas Pong against a bot opponent, three difficulty levels, multi-round progression with a color shift and speed increase each round, keyboard and touch-drag paddle control.

items.name: dino-runner-game
items.title: Dino Runner Game
items.description: A canvas endless-runner in the style of the offline dino game, pixel-drawn running dino, procedurally spawned cactus obstacles, three difficulty speeds, tap/space/arrow-up to jump, and a high-score tracker.

items.name: space-invaders-game
items.title: Space Invaders Game
items.description: A canvas Space Invaders, a descending grid of pixel-drawn invaders that shoot back, three difficulty levels, keyboard controls on desktop and on-screen move/fire buttons on mobile, with a win/lose end screen.

items.name: glow-jump-widget
items.title: Glow Jump Widget
items.description: A floating-action-button popup that opens a glowing 4-level platformer, jump between walls, dodge moving lava, and collect coins to finish each level, keyboard and on-screen touch controls included.

items.name: spin-to-win-wheel
items.title: Spin to Win Wheel
items.description: A gamified discount-capture widget where visitors spin a weighted SVG prize wheel for a reward, with five glass themes, a themed reveal modal and code copy, rendered inline or as a corner-launched popup with manual/delay/scroll triggers.

items.name: memory-cards-widget
items.title: Memory Cards Widget
items.description: A floating-action-button popup that opens a color-matching memory game, 3 difficulty levels, a live timer/move counter, best-score tracking, subtle Web Audio sound effects, and a confetti win screen.

items.name: bubble-cursor
items.title: Bubble Cursor
items.description: A liquid-glass bubble that follows the pointer across the whole page, rendered with a raymarched WebGL2 metaball trail with fresnel shading and iridescent glints, plus an optional light/dark theme toggle.

items.name: review-card-portrait
items.title: Review Card Portrait
items.description: A portrait-format testimonial card with a crossfading top image strip, counter, thumbnail selector, and an animated quote with name/role, plus prev/next navigation and optional autoplay.

items.name: cinematic-stacked-gallery
items.title: Cinematic Stacked Gallery
items.description: A fullscreen hero gallery where inactive slides collapse into a stacked deck of thumbnails; clicking one crossfades it to full size with Ken Burns zoom, cursor parallax, and a title/description rail with CTA and prev/next controls.

items.name: dice-roll-discount-popup
items.title: Dice Roll Discount Popup
items.description: A gamified discount-capture widget where visitors roll two 3D dice for a reward tier, with a themed reveal modal and code copy, rendered inline or as a corner-launched popup with manual/delay/scroll triggers.

items.name: error-404-page-section
items.title: 404 Page Section
items.description: A centered "page not found" section: a big glitching error code, heading, description and one or two pill buttons. Follows the host site's theme by default (or a fixed dark / light palette with an optional theme toggle) and scales with its own width.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast Stack
items.description: A stacked toast notification system: toasts pile up in a layered stack that fans out on hover, with six tones including a loading state that turns into a result, auto-dismiss that pauses on hover, swipe to dismiss and an action button.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification Center
items.description: A bell button with an unread badge that opens a notification panel: All and Unread tabs, Today and Earlier groups, unread dots, mark as read on click, mark all as read, per-item remove and full keyboard support.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: A presence and status indicator: online, away, busy, offline and live dots with an optional label, a pulsing ring for live states, and a pinned mode that sits on an avatar's corner behind a cut-out ring.

items.name: inline-validation-message
items.title: Inline Validation Message
items.description: A field-level validation message with error, warning, success and info states: it slides open under the field, crossfades when the text changes, shakes once when an error appears, and lives in a live region so screen readers announce it.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A button-triggered menu with icons, keyboard shortcuts, checkbox and radio items, labelled sections, nested submenus and a highlight that slides from row to row, with full keyboard support including typeahead.

items.name: mega-menu
items.title: Mega Menu
items.description: A pill navigation bar whose menus open one shared panel: it morphs to each menu's size, slides the content in from the side you moved to, and holds columns of icon links plus a featured card, with hover intent and keyboard support.

items.name: mobile-tab-bar
items.title: Mobile Tab Bar
items.description: A bottom navigation bar for phones: a pill slides behind the active tab and its icon bounces, with badge counts, an optional raised centre action, docked or floating styles, blurred glass and safe-area padding.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: Table of Contents
items.description: An 'On this page' table of contents for articles and docs: it tracks the section in view, slides a marker along its rail (filling it like reading progress), indents subsections, and smooth-scrolls to a heading on click. Collects headings automatically.

items.name: scrollspy-anchor-links
items.title: Scrollspy Anchor Links
items.description: A sticky horizontal bar of section links (Overview, Features, Specs, Reviews) that follows the section in view with a sliding pill or underline, keeps the current link scrolled into view on phones, and fills a progress line as you read.

items.name: language-switcher
items.title: Language Switcher
items.description: A language picker: a globe button whose name rolls to the new language, opening a searchable list of native names with codes and a check on the current one, or a segmented row of codes for two to four languages.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox Group
items.description: A group of checkboxes with a Select all row that shows a dash when only some are picked, checks that draw themselves, list or card layouts, a maximum that disables the rest, a live count and an error state.

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom Sheet
items.description: A mobile bottom sheet that slides up over a dimmed backdrop, rests at snap points you drag between from its handle, closes on a downward flick, and keeps its own content scrollable.

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: An image lightbox for any grid of photos: the thumbnail morphs into the full view, then arrows, keys and swipes step through, double-click zooms and pans, a swipe down closes, and a thumbnail strip tracks where you are.

items.name: cookie-consent-banner
items.title: Cookie Consent Banner
items.description: A cookie consent banner as a corner card or a bottom bar: accept all, reject all with equal weight, or open per-category switches (necessary locked on), and the choice is remembered, with a small button to change it later.

items.name: product-tour
items.title: Product Tour
items.description: A guided product tour: a spotlight glides from element to element over a dimmed page while a card beside it explains each one, with progress dots, Back, Next and Skip, arrow keys, and automatic placement on the side that has room.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: An inline month calendar for picking one day, a range or several days, with event dots under their days, an agenda for the selected day, months that slide in from the side they come from, a month picker, week numbers and full keyboard control.

items.name: basic-carousel
items.title: Basic Carousel
items.description: A plain, dependable carousel: drag or swipe between slides, arrows and dots, one to four slides in view, looping, and optional autoplay whose progress fills the active dot and pauses whenever someone hovers, focuses or drags.

items.name: sparkline-stat
items.title: Sparkline Stat
items.description: A KPI card with a sparkline: the number counts to its new value, a change badge says how far it moved, range tabs swap the series with a redraw, and scrubbing the chart turns the headline into that point's value.

items.name: checklist
items.title: Checklist
items.description: An onboarding checklist: a progress bar and count up top, round checks that draw in and strike the step through, the next step opening by itself with its own action button, a fold-away header and an all-done state.

items.name: icon-list
items.title: Icon List
items.description: A list with an icon on every line for features, benefits and what's included: checks that draw themselves in as the rows fade up, dimmed and struck-through lines for what isn't included, optional descriptions, and one or two columns.

items.name: icon-box
items.title: Icon Box
items.description: A feature box with an icon, title and text for features and services grids: in the card style a light follows the pointer along the border, the icon tile lifts and tilts on hover, and a linked box nudges its arrow forward.

items.name: data-view
items.title: Data View
items.description: A collection view that switches between a card grid and a list, with every item gliding to its new place; a sort menu reorders them with the same motion, and a pager steps through pages.

items.name: sortable-list
items.title: Sortable List
items.description: A list people can put in their own order: drag a row by its handle and the others slide out of the way, or use the keyboard (Space to lift, arrows to move, Space to drop, Escape to undo), with live position numbers and optional remove buttons.

items.name: organization-chart
items.title: Organization Chart
items.description: An org chart of people cards joined by rounded connector lines: teams open and close from a count chip under each manager, and picking someone lights up their reporting line all the way to the top.

items.name: transfer-list
items.title: Transfer List
items.description: Two lists side by side for moving items from one set to another, such as available and granted permissions: tick items and send them across with the arrows (or double-click one), move everything at once, search each side, and watch rows glide between the lists.

items.name: tree-table
items.title: Tree Table
items.description: A table whose rows nest, like files in folders: open and close branches with a chevron, parents add up their children (folder sizes), sort any column with folders kept on top, and tick rows with checkboxes that select whole branches.

items.name: chat-bubble
items.title: Chat Bubble
items.description: Chat message bubbles for both sides of a conversation: runs from the same person group together with tight inner corners and one avatar, outgoing messages show sending, delivered and read ticks, reactions pop in under a bubble, and a typing bubble bounces while someone writes.

items.name: list-group
items.title: List Group
items.description: A framed group of rows for settings menus and navigation lists: icons, descriptions, count badges, a danger row for destructive actions, and in selectable mode an active highlight that slides from row to row with arrow-key navigation.

items.name: basic-table
items.title: Basic Table
items.description: A clean, semantic table for showing data as it is: plain, striped or bordered, comfortable or compact, a caption and a totals row, custom cells such as status pills, a sticky header that casts a shadow once you scroll, and rows that fade in on load.

items.name: blockquote
items.title: Blockquote
items.description: A quote with its author: a rule on the left, a large quotation mark, a framed card or a big centred pull quote, revealed as it scrolls into view with a highlighter sweeping across the phrase that matters.

items.name: masonry-grid
items.title: Masonry Grid
items.description: A masonry layout for tiles of different heights: each tile drops into the shortest column while keeping left-to-right order, the column count follows the container's width, and tiles spring to their new places when it changes.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: A bento layout of feature cells that span columns and rows, fall back to two and then one column as the container narrows, fade in one after another, and light up under the pointer, with a demo set of small live visuals.

items.name: sticky-header
items.title: Sticky Header
items.description: A site header that stays out of the way: it slides up while you scroll down and comes back the moment you scroll up, turns compact and frosted after the first few pixels, shows reading progress along its edge, and folds its links into a menu on narrow screens.

items.name: section-container
items.title: Section Container
items.description: A page-section wrapper that keeps widths, padding and headings consistent: an optional eyebrow, title and description, grid, dot or glow backgrounds that fade out at the edges, framed side rails with corner marks, and a gentle reveal as it scrolls in.

items.name: shape-divider
items.title: Shape Divider
items.description: SVG dividers that shape the edge between two sections: waves that drift in a seamless loop, a curve, a tilt, a peak, a zigzag or steps, layered in up to three tones, at the top or bottom of a section and mirrored if you like.

items.name: fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: A grouped form section on the native fieldset: the legend sits in a notch in the border, the group folds away to a one-line summary, a tick appears once it's complete, an error outlines it in coral, and disabling it disables every control inside.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: A light / dark switch that morphs a sun into a moon, or a Light · System · Dark control with a sliding pill; it remembers the choice, follows the OS in System mode, writes the theme to <html>, and can grow the new theme out of the button in a circle.

items.name: share-buttons
items.title: Share Buttons
items.description: Share buttons for X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Reddit, WhatsApp and email with a copy-link button that turns into a tick: round icons with hover labels, labelled pills, or a single Share button that fans out into the row, plus the device's own share sheet where it exists.

items.name: social-links
items.title: Social Links
items.description: Links to your profiles in three styles: round icons that fill from the bottom and tilt on hover, a list with handles, follower counts and an out arrow, or a dock whose icons grow as the pointer comes near.

items.name: scroll-progress-bar
items.title: Scroll Progress Bar
items.description: Reading progress in three forms: a thin spring-smoothed bar, a corner ring with the percentage that becomes a back-to-top button at the end, or a track split into your page's sections that labels the current one and jumps to any other.

items.name: payment-button
items.title: Payment Button
items.description: A pay button that shows every step of a payment: the amount, a spinner while it processes, a drawn tick when it's paid, a shake and a clear message when a card is declined, and an optional press-and-hold mode that fills up before it charges.

items.name: speed-dial
items.title: Speed Dial
items.description: A floating action button that opens into a short menu of actions: the plus turns into a close cross while actions spring out one after another in a line or a quarter-circle fan, each with a label, with an optional dimmed backdrop and full keyboard control.

items.name: animate-on-scroll
items.title: Animate on Scroll
items.description: A wrapper that brings content in as it scrolls into view: fade from any side, zoom, blur, flip or a clip-path wipe, one block at once or each child in turn, once or every time, watching the window or any scroll box.

items.name: focus-trap
items.title: Focus Trap
items.description: Keeps keyboard focus inside a dialog, drawer or menu while it's open: Tab and Shift+Tab loop through its controls, focus starts where you choose and returns to where it was, Escape calls you back, and an optional ring glides to whatever has focus.

items.name: icon-swap-toggle
items.title: Icon Swap Toggle
items.description: A toggle button that swaps between two icons with a rotate, 3D flip, pop or slide: ready-made pairs for play/pause, mute, like, save, show/hide, menu/close, light/dark and copy/copied, or any two icons of your own.

items.name: ripple-click-effect
items.title: Ripple Click Effect
items.description: A wrapper that makes any surface ripple where it's pressed: the wave grows while the pointer is held and fades when it lets go, several can overlap, icon buttons can ripple from the centre, and Enter or Space ripples for keyboard users.

items.name: toggle-price-counter
items.title: Toggle Price Counter
items.description: A monthly / yearly billing switch whose price rolls to the new amount digit by digit like an odometer, with a saving badge that pops when yearly is picked and a line that spells out what's billed and saved.

items.name: animated-underline-link
items.title: Animated Underline Link
items.description: Text links with underlines that move: a line that slides in from the left and out to the right, opens from the centre, draws as a wave, fills behind the text, sweeps like a highlighter, or pushes an arrow, with a faint resting line so they still read as links.

items.name: image-shape-mask
items.title: Image Shape Mask
items.description: Masks an image into a shape (circle, squircle, arch, hexagon, flower, blob or diamond) that grows out from the centre as it scrolls into view and morphs smoothly into another shape on hover while the photo slowly zooms.

items.name: typography-prose
items.title: Typography Prose
items.description: Readable styles for rich text from Markdown or a CMS, without a plugin: balanced headings with hover # links, comfortable line length and rhythm, lists, quotes, inline code, code blocks with a Copy button, tables, marks and keys, scoped so they never leak into the rest of the page.

items.name: variant-swatches
items.title: Variant Swatches
items.description: Product option pickers for colour and size: round colour swatches with a ring that glides to the pick, size chips with a sliding fill, the chosen value named in the label, sold-out options struck through, and a low-stock warning when only a few are left.

items.name: content-switch
items.title: Content Switch
items.description: A switch that swaps the content below it: a pill or underline thumb slides to the chosen option, the new panel slides in from that side (or fades or blurs in), and the box eases to the new height instead of jumping.

items.name: floating-label-input
items.title: Floating Label Input
items.description: A text field whose label sits inside it and floats up on focus or once filled, in outlined (label in a notch in the border), filled or underline styles, with an optional icon, clear button, validity tick, character count, helper text and a shake on error.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Joins an input with text addons, icons, a select or a button into one field with one border and one focus ring: https:// and .com around a subdomain with a live availability tick, a price with a currency picker, a search with a shortcut, an invite with a send button.

items.name: masked-input
items.title: Masked Input
items.description: A formatted text field for phone numbers, dates, times, card numbers, ZIP codes or any pattern you define: separators fill themselves in, the rest of the template waits in faint ghost text, a thin bar tracks how much is filled, and a tick appears when it's complete.

items.name: knob
items.title: Knob
items.description: A rotary dial for picking a value in a range, like a mixer control: drag up or down, scroll or use the keyboard, with a 270° progress ring and a sliding thumb, or a physical-looking knob with an indicator and ticks that light up as it turns.

items.name: listbox
items.title: Listbox
items.description: An always-open list for picking one or several options: a search box that filters as you type, sticky group headings, avatars and descriptions, a highlight that follows the pointer or keyboard, checks that draw in, and type-ahead to jump by name.

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: Toggle Button
items.description: A button that stays pressed: the fill grows out from the middle, icons spin into their 'on' version, labels roll from Follow to Following and counts tick up by one. Outline, soft and ghost styles, icon-only or with text.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Buttons joined into one control: plain action groups like Previous / Today / Next, a single-choice group whose fill slides between options, multi-toggle groups, and a split button whose chevron opens a menu of alternative actions.

items.name: dual-range-slider
items.title: Dual Range Slider
items.description: A two-handle range filter with a histogram behind it: bars inside the range light up, the result count rolls as you drag, the filled part drags both ends together, and Min / Max fields stay in sync for exact numbers.

items.name: repeatable-field-group
items.title: Repeatable Field Group
items.description: A set of fields people can repeat: add a row, remove one, drag rows into order. Rows grow in and slide out, focus lands in the new row, Enter in the last row adds another, and min / max limits keep the list in bounds.

items.name: filter-chips
items.title: Filter Chips
items.description: A row of pill filters with counts: a check draws in and the chip grows to fit it, neighbours slide over instead of jumping, and a Clear chip appears once anything is on. The demo filters a list of open roles that reflows as you pick.

items.name: icon-action-button
items.title: Icon Action Button
items.description: A compact icon-only button for toolbars and table rows: solid, soft, outline or ghost, square or round, four sizes, a tooltip that names the action, a count badge, a loading spinner and a danger tone for destructive actions.

items.name: glossy-gradient-button
items.title: Glossy Gradient Button
items.description: A premium call-to-action button with a glossy face: a lit gradient, a glass highlight on the top half, a band of light that sweeps across on hover, an arrow that nudges forward, and a press that sinks. Ink, paper and four colour palettes, or your own two stops.

items.name: inline-link-button
items.title: Inline Link Button
items.description: A text button that looks like a link, for secondary actions: Forgot password?, View all, Undo, Remove, Read the docs. Neutral, muted, accent or danger, an underline that's always on, on hover or off, an arrow that nudges, and a ↗ for external links. Renders a link when you pass href, a button when you don't.

items.name: emoji-rating-scale
items.title: Emoji Rating Scale
items.description: A five-face satisfaction rating for quick feedback: hand-drawn faces from a frown to a wide smile that wobble on hover, fill with their own colour and pop when picked, a label that rolls in underneath, and full keyboard support as a radio group.

items.name: side-tab-menu
items.title: Side Tab Menu
items.description: A vertical tab menu for settings pages: tabs with icons, second-line descriptions and count badges, grouped under headings, an active highlight with a rail that slides between them, and a panel that fades to the chosen tab. Stacks on phones.

items.name: dot-pager-indicator
items.title: Dot Pager Indicator
items.description: Dots that show where you are in a carousel or onboarding flow: the active dot stretches into a pill, a progress style fills the pill and moves on by itself like stories, and a window style shows five dots out of many and shrinks the edge ones. Clickable and keyboard friendly.

items.name: vertical-progress-steps
items.title: Vertical Progress Steps
items.description: A live status tracker for multi-step processes like deploys, imports and order tracking: each step is done, running, waiting or failed, the connector fills as steps finish, the running step spins and shows its log lines, and screen readers hear every change.

items.name: auth-card
items.title: Auth Card
items.description: A sign-in, sign-up and forgot-password card in one: social sign-in buttons, email and password fields with inline validation, a show-password toggle, a password strength meter, a loading state driven by your onSubmit promise and a check-your-email screen.

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: Pricing Table
items.description: Pricing plans side by side with a monthly / yearly switch, prices that roll when the period changes, a highlighted plan with a badge, included and excluded features, and a custom-price plan for enterprise.

items.name: price-list-menu
items.title: Price List / Menu
items.description: A printed-menu style price list for cafés, salons and studios: section tabs with a sliding pill, dotted leaders to each price, sizes side by side, favourites and diet filters.

items.name: usage-price-calculator
items.title: Usage Price Calculator
items.description: A pay-as-you-go pricing calculator: sliders for requests, seats and storage, a live monthly estimate with a line-by-line breakdown, and bars comparing every plan so the cheapest one for that usage stands out.

items.name: a-la-carte-plan-builder
items.title: À la Carte Plan Builder
items.description: A build-your-own plan: pick modules, set seats and watch the total update, with bundle discounts that unlock as you add more, modules that bring their dependencies along, a yearly switch and a live summary.

items.name: credit-pack-picker
items.title: Credit Pack Picker
items.description: A credit top-up picker: packs that get cheaper per credit, a balance that counts up as you choose, what the pack is worth in images or minutes, and an auto top-up switch.

items.name: lifetime-deal-card
items.title: Lifetime Deal Card
items.description: A one-time-payment offer card: licence tiers, a struck-through price, a live countdown, spots left, a pays-for-itself line and a guarantee, with a soft glow to make it feel like an event.

items.name: volume-tier-graph
items.title: Volume Tier Graph
items.description: Tiered pricing you can see: a stepped price curve with a draggable marker, graduated or volume modes, a live total and average per unit, and the cost split across each tier.

items.name: flip-price-cards
items.title: Flip Price Cards
items.description: Pricing cards that keep the front clean: a big price on one side, and a springy 3D flip on hover or tap to reveal what's included and the call to action.

items.name: pricing-spotlight-carousel
items.title: Pricing Spotlight Carousel
items.description: A looping plan carousel with one card in the spotlight: neighbours recede and blur, the active card glows in its own colour with a light that follows the pointer, and you can swipe, click or use the arrow keys.

items.name: hanging-price-tags
items.title: Hanging Price Tags
items.description: Plans as paper price tags hanging from a rail: they swing like real pendulums when the pointer brushes past, the chosen tag drops lower on its string, and its details appear underneath.

items.name: faq-section
items.title: FAQ Section
items.description: A frequently asked questions section: heading and contact card on the left, an animated accordion on the right, optional category tabs and search, and FAQPage structured data for search engines.

items.name: contact-section
items.title: Contact Section
items.description: A contact section with a heading and your email, phone and address on the left, and a validated message form on the right: topic chips, a loading state driven by your onSubmit promise, inline errors and a thank-you screen.

items.name: simple-hero-section
items.title: Simple Hero Section
items.description: A landing page hero with an announcement pill, a headline whose words blur in one by one with an accent highlight, two buttons, avatar and rating proof, and a product window that rises in, over a grid and a glow that drifts toward the pointer.

items.name: split-screen-hero
items.title: Split Screen Hero
items.description: A two-sided hero with a shared headline: two full-bleed photos meet at a seam, and the half under the pointer opens up to show its description and button. Stacks on phones.

items.name: video-text-mask-hero
items.title: Video Text Mask Hero
items.description: A hero where a video plays through one giant word. Press play and the letters rush past the camera to open up the full film; Close or Escape brings them back.

items.name: parallax-layers-hero
items.title: Parallax Layers Hero
items.description: A drawn mountain range in depth layers that follow the pointer, with the headline set between the ridges so the near peaks pass in front of it. Takes your own artwork too.

items.name: spotlight-cursor-hero
items.title: Spotlight Cursor Hero
items.description: A hero in a dark room: the pointer carries a soft light that lights up the headline and uncovers notes hidden around it. Left alone, the light wanders by itself.

items.name: typewriter-search-hero
items.title: Typewriter Search Hero
items.description: A search-first hero whose box types out example searches by itself, then hands over to real search with live suggestions, highlighted matches and full keyboard support.

items.name: phone-fan-hero
items.title: Phone Fan Hero
items.description: An app launch hero: five phones open out from a stack into a fan, and the one you point at rises while its neighbours step aside. Comes with drawn screens, or use screenshots.

items.name: tile-flip-hero
items.title: Tile Flip Hero
items.description: A photo hero cut into a grid of tiles that flip in a wave to reveal the next picture. Click any tile and the wave starts from there. Autoplay can be paused.

items.name: bento-hero
items.title: Bento Hero
items.description: A hero built as a hairline bento grid: the headline shares the first screen with live cells, from counting totals and a period switch to uptime bars and rotating activity.

items.name: pricing-cards-section
items.title: Pricing Cards Section
items.description: A per-seat pricing section: a team size slider, monthly or yearly billing and a currency picker that recalculate every card's seat price and monthly total as they count, plans that grey out when the team is too big, and a compare all features table that opens below.

items.name: newsletter-signup-section
items.title: Newsletter Signup Section
items.description: A newsletter signup section: perks and reader proof on the left, a form card with email validation, weekly or monthly radio cards and topic chips on the right, a check-your-inbox screen with a resend cooldown, and a list of recent issues.

items.name: cta-banner-section
items.title: CTA Banner Section
items.description: A call-to-action banner: a rounded card with a light that travels around its border, a soft glow that follows the pointer over a faded grid, a headline, two buttons, a small note and a check list, centred or split into two columns.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo Cloud / Trusted By
items.description: A trusted-by logo grid with hairline cells where logos swap in place one at a time with a blur, a customer metric that slides up when a logo is hovered or focused, monochrome logos that light up, and pausing while people look.

items.name: integrations-grid
items.title: Integrations Grid
items.description: An integrations directory: search, category chips with counts, app cards with icon tiles, Popular and Connected badges, Connect and Disconnect buttons driven by your promise, a running connected count, and a request-an-integration card that doubles as the empty state.

items.name: portfolio-grid-block
items.title: Portfolio Grid Block
items.description: A portfolio grid with wide and tall tiles packed densely, a sliding category filter that reflows the grid, hover reveals with client and year, and a lightbox with details, next and previous, keyboard arrows and Escape.

items.name: booking-reservation-form
items.title: Booking / Reservation Form
items.description: A booking form in one card: service cards, a month calendar with closed days and keyboard navigation, time slots built from your opening hours with booked ones struck out, a guest counter, contact fields, a live summary and a confirmation screen.

items.name: blog-section
items.title: Blog Section
items.description: A blog section with a featured post card, category tabs with a sliding pill, an editorial list of posts where a thumbnail follows the cursor over each row, and a Show more button that reveals posts in pages.

items.name: content-section
items.title: Content Section
items.description: A long-form content section: a sticky side column with the title, read time, a scroll-linked progress bar and chapter links that follow your reading, next to chapters built from paragraphs, numbered lists, images with captions, pull quotes and stat rows that reveal as you scroll.

items.name: waitlist-form-block
items.title: Waitlist Form Block
items.description: A waitlist signup block: one email field, then your place in line counting into view with a progress bar, an invite link to copy or share that moves you up for every friend who joins, reward tiers that unlock, and a live waiting count.

items.name: open-roles-board
items.title: Open Roles Board Section
items.description: A careers board: search, department chips with live counts, remote, hybrid and on-site toggles, roles grouped by department in expandable rows with summary, highlights, pay and an apply link, New badges for fresh roles, and a get-notified form.

items.name: transactions-table
items.title: Transactions Table Block
items.description: A transactions table for finance screens: money in, money out and net for 7, 30 or 90 days with a drawn trend line, type filters with counts, search, rows grouped by day with daily totals, status dots, a detail drawer and CSV export.

items.name: leaderboard
items.title: Leaderboard Block
items.description: A leaderboard with a medal podium for the top three, a ranked list with progress bars and up or down arrows against the previous period, period, metric and team switches that re-rank everyone with smooth motion, and your own row pinned at the bottom when you are further down.

items.name: invoice-list
items.title: Invoice List Block
items.description: An invoice list with status tabs that show their totals, an aging bar that splits what is outstanding by how late it is, checkboxes for sending reminders or marking invoices paid in bulk, overdue badges and a download button that builds a real PDF.

items.name: file-manager
items.title: File Manager Block
items.description: A file manager with breadcrumb folders, a grid and list view, a storage bar split by file type, drag and drop uploads with progress, inline rename and delete with undo.

items.name: audit-log-table
items.title: Audit Log Table Block
items.description: An audit log with severity and actor filters, search, rows that open to show who did what from where plus a before and after diff, a live stream switch that slides new events in at the top and a JSON export of whatever is filtered.

items.name: ai-search-results
items.title: AI Search Results Block
items.description: An AI search page: a question bar, an AI overview that shows searching, reading and writing steps before streaming an answer with numbered citations, ranked results with highlighted terms and type tabs, and a People also ask panel.

items.name: agent-task-progress
items.title: Agent Task Progress Block
