items.description: A live view of an AI agent working through a task: goal, status, gradient progress bar, elapsed time and tokens, a step timeline with tool chips and streaming logs, an automatic retry after a failure, a step that waits for your approval, pause and stop controls, and downloadable files at the end.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model Picker Block
items.description: A model picker for an AI chat composer: a searchable menu grouped by provider with Auto, favorites, capability filters, New, Beta and locked Pro models, a detail panel with intelligence and speed meters, context and price, and a thinking effort switch that appears for reasoning models.

items.name: prompt-library
items.title: Prompt Library Block
items.description: A library of reusable AI prompts: categories, search, popular, recent and favorite sorting, cards that highlight {{variables}}, a side panel that builds a form from those variables with a live preview, Copy and Use in chat, and a New prompt form that finds variables as you type.

items.name: ai-chat-bubble-launcher
items.title: AI Chat Bubble Launcher
items.description: A floating support launcher for any page: a gradient-ringed bubble with an unread badge, a proactive teaser with quick-reply chips, and a panel with Home, Messages and Help tabs, streamed AI answers, a hand-off to a person and searchable help articles.

items.name: chat-history-sidebar
items.title: Chat History Sidebar
items.description: The history sidebar of an AI chat app: conversations grouped by date with pinned chats on top, project folders that filter the list, search with highlighted matches, a row menu to rename, pin, archive, move or delete with undo, a collapsible icon rail and a drawer on small screens.

items.name: ai-image-generation-grid
items.title: AI Image Generation Grid
items.description: A text-to-image workspace: a prompt panel with aspect ratio, style, model and seed controls, a feed of four-image runs that denoise step by step, hover actions to vary, upscale or like each image, and a lightbox with download.

items.name: execution-detail-view
items.title: Execution Detail View
items.description: A full record of one AI agent run: status and totals at the top, every step with its timing, and the input, output and log behind each one.

items.name: bot-template-showcase
items.title: Bot Template Showcase
items.description: A gallery of ready-made AI bots: search and filter by team, open one to see what it does and connects to, and add it to your workspace.

items.name: operations-command-deck
items.title: Operations Command Deck
items.description: One screen for running a fleet of AI bots: live totals, a traffic chart, alerts to clear, what every bot is doing, and a guarded switch to pause them all.

items.name: launch-phase-timeline
items.title: Launch Phase Timeline
items.description: Roll out an AI feature in safe steps: a stepped curve of who has it, the checks each phase must pass, and controls to open it wider or roll it back.

items.name: kpi-dashboard-grid
items.title: KPI Dashboard Grid
items.description: A dashboard overview grid: a large featured chart and KPI cards with counting numbers, change against the previous period (inverse for metrics like churn), hoverable sparklines or goal bars, a period switch, a compare toggle with dashed previous lines, and a Customize menu to show or hide metrics.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity Feed
items.description: A team activity feed grouped by day: comments with @mentions, status changes shown as from → to pills, file uploads, deploys and new members, emoji reactions you can toggle, inline replies, filter tabs with counts, unread dots with Mark all as read, and a pill that collects new activity until you choose to show it.

items.name: recent-orders-table
items.title: Recent Orders Table Block
items.description: A store's recent orders: today's count and revenue, status tabs with counts, search across orders, customers and products, rows with product thumbnails, payment pills and a four-step fulfillment tracker, and an expandable panel with line items, totals, shipping steps and a button that moves the order to its next step. New orders slide in live.

items.name: billing-summary-card
items.title: Billing Summary Card
items.description: A subscription billing card: plan and renewal date, a monthly or annual switch with the yearly saving, a seat stepper that cannot drop below seats in use, usage meters that warn near their limits, a live next-invoice breakdown with VAT, saved payment cards, and a two-step cancel with undo.

items.name: team-members-list
items.title: Team Members List Block
items.description: A workspace members list for settings pages: a seats meter, search, an invite form that turns typed or pasted emails into chips and flags bad ones, role selects that protect the last owner, pending invites with Resend, 2FA badges, last-active status and remove with an inline confirmation.

items.name: quick-actions-grid
items.title: Quick Actions Grid
items.description: A grid of shortcut tiles for a dashboard home: coloured icons with a hover glow and a ripple when pressed, number keys 1–9 to run them, a filter, a Recent row, and an Edit mode where tiles wiggle, can be removed and new ones added from a library.

items.name: usage-chart
items.title: Usage Chart Block
items.description: A usage panel for metered plans: daily stacked bars by source with a daily budget line, a cumulative view with the plan limit and a dashed projection to cycle end, used / projected / overage figures, a status line that names the day you will pass your limit, hover breakdowns and legend toggles.

items.name: onboarding-checklist-widget
items.title: Onboarding Checklist Widget
items.description: A floating setup guide for the corner of an app: a progress ring that shrinks into a pill showing the next step, steps grouped into sections with their own counts, one step open at a time with its time estimate and action button, Skip for now, a reward for finishing, confetti, and dismiss with a way back.

items.name: multi-step-form
items.title: Multi-step Form Block
items.description: A complete create-a-workspace wizard: a step rail with checks, a name field that writes the web address with a live availability check, plan cards with a monthly or annual switch, email invites, a review page with Edit links and a success screen. Each step validates before moving on and slides in from the direction you are going.

items.name: inbox-message-list
items.title: Inbox / Message List Block
items.description: A two-pane inbox: Inbox, Starred and Archive folders with an unread count, search, rows with unread dots, labels and attachment icons, checkboxes for bulk mark-read and archive, a reading pane with attachments and a reply box, keyboard shortcuts and archive with undo. On phones the list and the message take turns.

items.name: workflow-builder
items.title: Workflow Builder Block
items.description: An automation builder on a dotted canvas: a trigger, steps and an if/else condition that splits into Yes and No branches, + buttons on every line that insert emails, waits, webhooks and more, an inspector to rename or delete steps, a Test run that lights up each step in turn, and a Draft / Live switch.

items.name: map-block
items.title: Map Block
items.description: A live delivery map for a dashboard: a drawn city with river, parks and roads, drivers moving along dashed routes that fill in as they go, stops that tick off, a sidebar with ETAs and progress, filters for on-time and delayed, click to zoom to a driver with a stops card, drag to pan and zoom controls.

items.name: whats-new-widget
items.title: What's New / In-app Changelog Widget
items.description: An in-app changelog that opens from a ✦ What's new button with an unread count: a spotlight card for the big release, New, Improved and Fixed tags with filter tabs, entries that expand for details, unread dots, Mark all as read, a Helpful? vote on each update and an email subscription switch.

items.name: referral-widget
items.title: Referral Widget
items.description: A refer-a-friend card: give-and-get explainer, your link with a Copy button that flips to Copied, quick share links, email invites, how much you have earned, a milestone track that unlocks bonuses with confetti, and your friends' progress from invited to subscribed with reminders.

items.name: app-shell-sidebar
items.title: App Shell, Sidebar Layout
items.description: An application shell with a left sidebar: workspace switcher, main navigation with badges and a sliding active highlight, a collapsible Projects group, Docs and Settings, a user menu, a top bar with breadcrumb, ⌘K search and a New button, a sidebar that collapses to icons, and an off-canvas drawer on phones.

items.name: app-shell-stacked
items.title: App Shell, Stacked Layout
items.description: An application shell with everything stacked on top: a top bar with brand, main navigation and a sliding underline, search, a notifications dropdown with unread dots and an account menu, then a page header with breadcrumb, title, favourite star, status, actions and section tabs, and a hamburger menu on phones.

items.name: app-shell-multi-column
items.title: App Shell, Multi-column Layout
items.description: A multi-column application shell: an icon rail for sections with tooltips, a filterable list column, the selected item in the main pane and a details column you can show or hide. Switching sections swaps the list with a stagger, and on phones the list and detail take turns.

items.name: detail-screen
items.title: Detail Screen
items.description: A full record page for a customer, project or account: header with status, Follow, a primary action and a More menu, a stats strip, Overview, Activity and Notes tabs, fields you edit in place with Enter or Escape and a Saved tick, plus a sidebar with owner, removable tags and open deals.

items.name: settings-screen
items.title: Settings Screen
items.description: A settings page with section navigation (Profile, Workspace, Appearance, Danger zone), labelled form rows with validation, theme cards, accent colours and density, an unsaved-changes bar that slides up with Discard and Save, dots on sections with pending edits, and a typed confirmation before deleting the workspace.

items.name: page-heading
items.title: Page Heading
items.description: A page heading in three variants (simple, with meta details, with a cover and avatar): breadcrumb, a title you can rename in place, a Draft or Published status, Copy link that confirms, Preview, a Publish button that flips its label, and a More menu that holds actions on narrow screens.

items.name: section-heading
items.title: Section Heading
items.description: A section heading for inside a page: title with a count, description, a search that expands from an icon, a primary action, status tabs with counts, a sort menu and a grid or list switch, wired to the content under it so filtering, sorting and layout changes animate.

items.name: card-heading
items.title: Card Heading
items.description: Three working card headings: a person heading with avatar, time, a Follow button and a ⋯ menu (pin, copy link, hide with undo), a title and description heading with a period menu that redraws a chart, and a settings heading with a switch and a collapse toggle.

items.name: grid-list
items.title: Grid List
items.description: A grid list of people for an app: cards with avatar, presence dot, role and team, Email and Call actions, a star that pins favourites to the front, team filters with counts, search, Show more, and multi-select with a floating bar to message everyone selected.

items.name: stacked-list
items.title: Stacked List
items.description: A stacked A to Z contact list: sticky letter headings that light up as you scroll, an alphabet index on the side that jumps to a letter, search, rows with avatar or initials, tags and last contact, arrow-key navigation, and rows that open to show email and call actions.

items.name: action-panel
items.title: Action Panel
items.description: A stack of action panels for an account page, each a title, a sentence and one action that really works: export with progress and a JSON download, two-step verification with recovery codes to copy, an inline billing email change, ownership transfer with a warning step, and leave workspace behind a typed confirmation.

items.name: form-layout
items.title: Form Layout
items.description: A full settings form laid out in sections, with titles on the left and fields in cards on the right: profile with a workspace URL that follows the name, a brand color picker and a character counter, a billing contact address grid, and email and push notification choices. Changed fields get a dot, a sticky bar counts unsaved changes, and saving checks every field and jumps to the first problem.

items.name: radio-group-cards
items.title: Radio Group Cards
items.description: A create-resource screen built from radio card groups: plan cards with prices and features, region cards with latency bars and one at capacity, and compute size cards that lock on the free plan. A sliding selection outline moves between cards, a monthly or yearly switch reprices everything, and a summary with an animated total creates the database.

items.name: vertical-navigation
items.title: Vertical Navigation
items.description: A documentation-style vertical navigation with collapsible sections, nested pages on a guide line, a sliding active pill and marker, a filter that highlights matches (press /), arrow-key movement, and a content pane with breadcrumbs and previous / next links. On phones it folds into a menu button that shows the current page.

items.name: event-calendar
items.title: Event Calendar
items.description: A full calendar screen with month and week views: color-coded event chips you can drag to another day, a time-grid week with a now line, quick event creation, event details with move and delete, calendar filters with counts, a selected-day agenda and arrow-key day navigation. On phones days show dots and the agenda sits under the grid.

items.name: gantt-chart
items.title: Gantt Chart
items.description: A project timeline with tasks grouped into collapsible phases, bars you drag to move or stretch to resize, milestones, dependency arrows that turn red and dashed when a task starts too early, one-click auto-scheduling, day and week zoom, a today line, keyboard moves and a details bar with a progress slider.

items.name: dashboard-header
items.title: Dashboard Header
items.description: A complete dashboard header: a top bar with a workspace switcher, tabs with a sliding underline, ⌘K search that expands in place with keyboard results, notifications with unread counts and mark all read, and an account menu, over a page header with a live status line, a date range control that updates a KPI strip, and export with progress.

items.name: dashboard-footer
items.title: Dashboard Footer
items.description: An app footer with a live status bar: a pulsing system status that opens 30-day uptime bars per service, region and latency, last synced with Sync now, a version badge with a What's new panel, a language menu, page feedback, and a keyboard shortcuts dialog on ? with a filter.

items.name: multi-view-switcher
items.title: Multi View Switcher
items.description: One set of items shown as a list grouped by status, a board with columns or a gallery of cards, and every card flies to its new place when you switch. Search, owner filters and sorting apply to all views, 1 / 2 / 3 switch views from the keyboard, and changing an item's status in the details panel moves it to its new group.

items.name: video-call-ui
items.title: Video Call UI
items.description: A complete meeting screen: participant tiles with an active-speaker ring and live audio bars, grid and speaker layouts that morph, screen sharing with a filmstrip, mute, camera, raise hand, floating emoji reactions, a chat you can type in, a people list, a running call timer, keyboard shortcuts, and leave with rejoin.

items.name: user-schedule
items.title: User Schedule
items.description: A weekly availability editor: a switch per day, any number of time ranges with overlap and order checks, copy one day's hours to other days, a time zone, days off by date, a live week preview with total hours, and a save bar that blocks saving until every range is valid.

items.name: checkbox-selection-cards
items.title: Checkbox Selection Cards
items.description: A multi-select onboarding step built from checkbox cards: priced add-ons with a select-all that shows a mixed state, and topics limited to three that lock the rest and shake when you try a fourth. Choices appear as removable chips in a sticky summary with an animated monthly total and Continue.

items.name: brand-color-settings-panel
items.title: Brand Color Settings Panel
items.description: A theme editor for a product's brand: primary and accent colors with a picker, hex field and presets, an 11-step scale generated from the primary, a live contrast check for text on the brand color, a corner radius slider, and a light and dark preview of real UI that updates as you edit. Copy the CSS variables or save the theme.

items.name: spotlight-search-panel
items.title: Spotlight Search Panel
items.description: A global search overlay for an app: one field that searches pages, people, files and actions with fuzzy matching and highlighted letters, scope tabs with live counts that Tab cycles through, grouped results driven by the keyboard, a rich preview of the highlighted result, and recent searches.

items.name: date-range-picker-presets
items.title: Date Range Picker with Presets
items.description: A dashboard date range control: a trigger that shows the range and its comparison, a popover with presets, typed start and end dates, a two-month calendar where the range previews as you hover, future days disabled, a compare-to period drawn under the calendar, and Apply updating the numbers and chart behind it.

items.name: otp-verification-block
items.title: OTP / Verification Code Block
items.description: A complete two-step verification screen: text, authenticator or email codes, six boxes with auto-advance, paste and auto-submit, a shake and attempts left on a wrong code, a timed lockout, a resend cooldown, an authenticator refresh ring, recovery codes, trust this device, and a success state.

items.name: password-strength-meter
items.title: Password Strength Meter
items.description: A create-password screen that explains strength instead of just scoring it: entropy in bits and an estimated time to crack, a five-step meter, live checks for length, variety, runs, keyboard patterns, your name or email and leaked passwords, a tip for the first problem, a passphrase generator, copy and show, and saving only once it's strong.

items.name: reset-password-card
items.title: Reset Password Card
items.description: The screen behind a reset link: it checks the link, then asks for a new password with live rule chips, a confirm field that shows when they match, an expiry countdown and sign out of other devices, and finishes with a countdown into the app. Expired links get their own state with a send-a-new-link flow and resend cooldown.

items.name: verify-email-card
items.title: Verify Email Card
items.description: A check-your-inbox screen after sign-up: an animated envelope with a sent counter, the masked address with an inline fix for typos, open email app, an I've-clicked-the-link check that tells people when it isn't done yet, a resend with cooldown and limit, tips for finding the email, and a verified state with a small burst.

items.name: split-sign-in-testimonial
items.title: Split Sign In with Testimonial
items.description: A two-column sign-in page: a form with passkey and single sign-on, domain detection that offers SSO for company emails, show password, keep me signed in and clear errors, next to a testimonial panel that rotates customer quotes with story-style progress bars, pauses on hover, and highlights the matching company in a logo row.

items.name: record-detail-drawer
items.title: Record Detail Drawer
items.description: A CRM-style accounts table with a record drawer that slides in from the right: next and previous with J / K, a stage picker that logs to the activity feed, click-to-edit fields that save on Enter, copy email, call and email shortcuts, and Overview / Activity / Notes tabs with a note composer.

items.name: account-menu-dropdown
items.title: Account Menu Dropdown
items.description: The menu behind an app's avatar, done properly: profile header with plan, a custom status with emoji, availability that recolors the avatar dot, a workspace switcher, shortcuts for each item, an appearance switch that really changes the theme, a confirm step before signing out, and full keyboard support with type-ahead.

items.name: upload-queue-panel
items.title: Upload Queue Panel
items.description: An upload manager for many files: drag in or browse real files, two uploads at a time with the rest queued, per-file progress with time left, pause, resume, cancel and retry, a total bar with speed, filters for in progress, done and failed, clear done, and a minimize-to-pill mode with a progress ring.

items.name: advanced-filter-builder
items.title: Advanced Filter Builder
items.description: A query builder for data tables: conditions made of field, operator and value with operators that fit the field type, and / or toggles, one level of grouping, a plain-English sentence of the filter, saved views, copy as JSON, and a results table that filters live.

items.name: invite-members-modal
items.title: Invite Members Modal
items.description: An invite dialog that handles the real cases: paste a list and it becomes chips, bad addresses turn red, existing members and pending invites are caught, each person gets a role, a seat meter warns before you go over the plan, an optional message, a shareable invite link with expiry and reset, and a success list.

items.name: share-settings-modal
items.title: Share Settings Modal
items.description: A share dialog for a document: add people from a directory with keyboard autocomplete, set each person's access or remove them, choose general access (restricted, everyone in the workspace, anyone with the link) with its own role, link settings for expiry, password and downloads, copy link and notify people.

items.name: notification-preferences-panel
items.title: Notification Preferences Panel
items.description: A notification settings screen: a matrix of events by channel with select-all columns, security alerts that can't be turned off, email frequency from instant to weekly, quiet hours with days, pause all with a banner, a test notification that slides in, and a save bar.

items.name: member-profile-card
items.title: Member Profile Card
items.description: A team directory with a rich profile card: pick someone from the list and see their status, local time, bio, stats and skills, follow them, message or copy their email, book a free slot for a meeting, and jump to their manager or teammates.

items.name: feedback-rating-card
items.title: Feedback Rating Card
items.description: An in-app feedback card with an NPS 0–10 or five-face satisfaction scale: colors that show detractors, passives and promoters as you hover, a follow-up question that depends on the score, quick-pick tags, a comment with a counter, permission to follow up, a thank-you that asks happy users for a review, and Not now that tucks it into a pill.

items.name: usage-limit-slider-card
items.title: Usage Limit Slider Card
items.description: A spending limit card for usage-based billing: a slider that shows what's spent (split by service), the month's forecast and the limit handle together, presets and a forecast + 20% shortcut, a live message saying whether and when you'll hit the limit, alert thresholds with amounts, what happens at the limit, and save.

items.name: settings-toggle-list
items.title: Settings Toggle List
items.description: A preferences page of grouped switches that save instantly: search with highlighted matches, settings that reveal a follow-up option when turned on, beta badges, a reload banner for settings that need it, a saved check on each change, an undo toast, a count of changes from default and reset per section.

items.name: connected-apps-toggle-list
items.title: Connected Apps Toggle List
items.description: An integrations list where each app has a switch that does the real flow: turning one on shows what it will be allowed to do before connecting, connected apps show the account and options to configure, expired ones ask to reconnect, and turning off asks for confirmation. With filters and search.

items.name: privacy-security-settings-panel
items.title: Privacy & Security Settings Panel
items.description: An account privacy and security page: a security checkup score ring with one-click fixes, active sessions with per-device and sign-out-all, recent sign-in activity with a flagged failed attempt, profile visibility and activity status, a data export with progress, and a type-to-confirm account deletion.

items.name: change-password-settings-card
items.title: Change Password Settings Card
items.description: A change-password card for account settings: current password with a forgot link, a new password with a four-step strength meter, a live requirements checklist, breach and reuse warnings, a confirm field that says when it matches, show/hide toggles, an option to sign out other devices, and a saving → updated state.

items.name: account-setup-sections
items.title: Account Setup Sections
items.description: A first-run account setup in collapsible sections: profile with avatar color and role chips, workspace name with an auto-generated URL, email invites as chips with validation, preferences, a segmented progress bar, completed sections that collapse to an editable summary, an optional skip and a finish card.

items.name: contacts-quick-list
items.title: Contacts Quick List
items.description: A two-pane contacts screen: search, All / Favorites / Online filters, a favorites avatar strip, an A–Z list with sticky letters and a jump index, presence dots, hover quick actions for message and call, and a detail pane with actions, favorite toggle and copyable email and phone.

items.name: premium-upgrade-upsell-card
items.title: Premium Upgrade Upsell Card
items.description: An in-app upgrade card shown near a plan limit: a rotating gradient border, a segmented usage meter, what Pro unlocks, a monthly / yearly switch with an animated per-seat price and savings, a seat stepper with the total, a free-trial button with loading and welcome states, and Maybe later that collapses it into a slim banner.

items.name: people-directory-table
items.title: People Directory Table
items.description: An HR people directory: search, status tabs with counts, a department filter, sortable name / team / location / start date columns, status pills, row and page selection with a bulk action bar for message and CSV export, pagination, and a card list on narrow screens.

items.name: time-off-request-panel
items.title: Time Off Request Panel
items.description: A time-off request screen: vacation / sick / personal balance cards that preview the request, a month calendar for picking a range that skips weekends and holidays, existing requests and teammates who are off marked on the days, half-day options, overlap and balance warnings, a note, and a requests list with pending items you can cancel.

items.name: payroll-run-summary
items.title: Payroll Run Summary
items.description: A payroll run review screen: status steps from draft to scheduled, counting totals for gross, net, taxes and deductions with a split bar and change vs last month, departments that expand to employees with prorations and commissions flagged, pre-run checks you resolve in place, and an approve → confirm → processing → scheduled flow.

items.name: hiring-pipeline-board
items.title: Hiring Pipeline Board
items.description: A recruiting pipeline screen for one role: a stage funnel bar, Applied → Screening → Interview → Offer → Hired columns with counts and reach rates, candidate cards with ratings, source, next step and days in stage (red after a week), drag and drop between stages, select-to-advance or reject, search, and undo toasts.

items.name: card-wallet-panel
items.title: Card Wallet Panel
items.description: A banking card manager: card tabs, a 3D card that flips to reveal the number, expiry and CVC (and hides itself again), copy number, a frosted freeze state, monthly spend against an adjustable limit, per-card controls for online, contactless, ATM and abroad, recent payments, and creating a new virtual card.

items.name: spending-by-category-chart
items.title: Spending by Category Chart
items.description: A personal finance spending breakdown: month total with budget left and change vs last month, a gapped donut with a center readout, ranked category bars with budget markers and over-budget flags, compare-with-last-month ghost bars, a table view, month stepping and a merchant drill-down per category.

items.name: money-transfer-form
items.title: Money Transfer Form
items.description: A bank transfer flow in three steps: pick the source account, a saved recipient or a new one with live IBAN formatting and a validity check, a big amount field with quick amounts and balance checks, instant vs standard speed with fees, reference and repeat; then a review summary with a press-and-hold send button and an animated success receipt.

items.name: savings-goal-tracker
items.title: Savings Goal Tracker
items.description: A savings goals screen: goal tabs with progress bars, a counting balance with a progress ring and an on-track finish date, a balance chart with a dashed projection to the goal line and a hover crosshair, quick and custom contributions with milestone messages, and an auto-save switch with a monthly amount slider that moves the finish date.

items.name: campaign-performance-overview
items.title: Campaign Performance Overview
items.description: A marketing campaign dashboard: channel filter and 7d / 30d / 90d range, six KPI tiles with change vs the previous period (four of them switch the chart), a daily line chart against a dashed previous period with crosshair tooltips, and a campaign list with budget pacing, ROAS, cost per conversion, sorting and pause / resume switches.

items.name: deals-pipeline-board
items.title: Deals Pipeline Board
items.description: A CRM sales pipeline: open pipeline, weighted forecast, won and win-rate tiles, owner filters, Lead → Qualified → Proposal → Negotiation → Won columns with totals and win probability, deal cards with value, owner and close date (stale ones flagged), drag and drop with a lost drop zone, a celebration burst on won deals, keyboard moves and undo.

items.name: lead-profile-panel
items.title: Lead Profile Panel
items.description: A CRM lead detail screen: contact header with tags, status and owner, email / call actions, convert-to-deal inline form, a lead score ring with Hot / Warm / Cold and an explainable factor breakdown, a 14-day visits bar chart, and an activity timeline with note logging plus a details tab.

items.name: product-highlight-block
items.title: Product Highlight Block
items.description: A featured product spotlight: a large photo with numbered hotspots that pulse and sync with a feature list, a floating caption card, rating, key stats, an optional add-on, an animated price and an add-to-cart button with loading and added states.

items.name: category-grid-block
items.title: Category Grid Block
items.description: A bento grid of shop categories: one large feature tile, wide and small tiles with product photos on a light surface, product counts and starting prices, badges like 'New season' or 'Up to 40% off', subcategory chips, hover zoom and a rotating arrow, plus an 'All products' link.

items.name: promo-banner-block
items.title: Promo Banner Block
items.description: A sale banner for store pages: a big headline that rises in word by word, a copyable discount code, a shop button, a live countdown to a real end date (hidden after it ends), terms, and a collage of product photos that drifts with the pointer next to a springy '40% off' sticker.

items.name: trust-badges-block
items.title: Trust Badges Block
items.description: A store reassurance strip: shipping, returns, warranty and secure checkout badges with icons that draw themselves, each opening the three facts behind the promise, plus an overall rating with partially filled stars and the accepted payment types shown as neutral icons.

items.name: related-products-block
items.title: Related Products Block
items.description: A 'You may also like' product row: tabs for similar items and complete-the-setup picks, a snap-scrolling carousel with arrow buttons and a scroll progress bar, sale and new badges, wishlist hearts, quick add on hover with a running bag count, prices and ratings.

items.name: product-quick-view-block
items.title: Product Quick View Block
items.description: A product grid with quick view: hover a card for a 'Quick view' button that opens a dialog with an image gallery, rating, price, color and size choices, quantity and add to cart, plus previous / next to browse the grid without closing it.

items.name: checkout-form-block
items.title: Checkout Form Block
items.description: A one-page checkout: contact, delivery with shipping method cards (address fields fold away for pickup), card payment with live formatting and checksum validation, inline errors after blur, discount codes, a sticky order summary with a counting total (collapsible on phones) and a processing → confirmed flow.

items.name: order-summary-block
items.title: Order Summary Block
items.description: An editable order summary card: line items with thumbnails, quantity steppers, struck-through original prices and remove with undo, 'show more' for long orders, a gift-wrap option with a note, a delivery estimate worked out in business days, collapsible price details, a counting total and a savings callout.

items.name: gift-card-block
items.title: Gift Card Block
items.description: A digital gift card section: a live card preview that tilts with the pointer and updates as you type, four code-drawn designs, preset and custom amounts with limits, recipient, sender, send-now-or-later and a message, add to cart, plus a 'Check balance' tab.

items.name: product-carousel-block
items.title: Product Carousel Block
items.description: A featured product carousel: one product per slide with a big title, specs, price and shop button, photos that glide in, autoplay with filling progress bars (pauses on hover, focus or the pause button), swipe and drag, arrow keys and prev / next buttons.

items.name: mini-cart-drawer
items.title: Mini Cart Drawer
items.description: A slide-in cart drawer with a store header and product row: adding a product bumps the bag count and opens the drawer, which shows a free-shipping progress bar, line items with steppers (the last one becomes a remove), a 'goes well with' upsell, an animated subtotal and checkout.

items.name: product-filters-sidebar
items.title: Product Filters Sidebar
items.description: A collection page with a filter sidebar: collapsible groups for category with live counts, a dual-handle price range over a price histogram, color swatches, minimum rating, in-stock and on-sale switches, removable active-filter chips, sorting, a result count and a grid that updates instantly (a toggle panel on phones).

items.name: coupon-code-block
items.title: Coupon Code Block
items.description: A discount code card: type a code (validated with a spinner, shaking with a clear message when invalid or below its minimum spend) or pick one of the available coupon tickets, with a 'Best value' tag, locked coupons that say how much more to add, an applied ticket with a confetti pop, and totals that count down.

items.name: order-bump-block
items.title: Order Bump Block
items.description: A checkout order bump: the main item plus one-time add-on offers in dashed boxes with a pulsing arrow and a passing shine, a checkbox that draws its check, discounted prices, option pills that unfold once added, summary lines that fold in, a counting total and a savings note.

items.name: free-shipping-progress-bar
items.title: Free Shipping Progress Bar
items.description: A tiered cart reward bar: free shipping, a free gift and free express milestones on one striped progress track, a message that says exactly how much more to add, milestone icons that pop when reached, an unlocked toast and 'close the gap' add-ons that pick the cheapest item that gets you there.

items.name: upsell-cross-sell-block
items.title: Upsell / Cross-sell Block
items.description: A post-add offer screen: choose between your pick and a highlighted upgrade with a side-by-side spec table that follows the choice, add accessories at a bundle discount with struck-through prices, and watch the total and savings update before adding everything to the cart.

items.name: incentives-block
items.title: Incentives Block
items.description: A 'why shop with us' section: a scrolling ticker of store perks, a headline, and four incentive cards (shipping, returns, recycled packaging, support) with code-drawn illustrations that come alive on hover, a big stat, a short explanation and a link.

items.name: order-history-block
items.title: Order History Block
items.description: An account orders page: status tabs with counts, search by order number or product, order cards with stacked thumbnails and colored status pills (a pulsing dot for orders on the way), expandable details with a delivery progress timeline, tracking number, line items and actions to track, buy again, return, cancel or download the invoice.

items.name: product-features-block
items.title: Product Features Block
items.description: A product feature tour: a vertical list of features with progress bars that autoplay through them, a large photo that crossfades and slowly zooms toward the part being described, a floating stat card, and a compact spec grid underneath.

items.name: product-reviews-block
items.title: Product Reviews Block
items.description: A product review list: average rating, sorting, filter chips for photos, star level and the topics people mention most, review cards with verified badges, purchased variant, read more, photos, store replies and a helpful vote, plus 'show more' paging.

items.name: store-navigation
items.title: Store Navigation
items.description: A complete store header: a dismissible announcement bar, a mega menu with link columns and a featured product per category, an expanding search with trending terms and live product suggestions, wishlist and bag counts, and a slide-in mobile menu with accordion sections.

items.name: welcome-offer-modal
items.title: Welcome Offer Modal
items.description: A first-visit welcome modal in three steps: pick one of three welcome perks (discount, free express shipping or a free gift), enter an email, then reveal a copyable code, with a split photo layout, progress bar, and calm exits.

items.name: cart-offer-modal
items.title: Cart Offer Modal
items.description: An add-to-cart modal with a mix-and-match deal: it confirms the item, shows how many more to add for the next discount tier on a progress track, lets shoppers add picks right in the modal with prices already discounted, and counts the savings and total as tiers unlock.

items.name: newsletter-discount-modal
items.title: Newsletter Discount Modal
items.description: A newsletter sign-up popup with a first-order discount: a sample issue on paper, weekly or drops-only frequency, interest chips and an email field, then a stamped letter and a perforated coupon ticket with copy, apply to cart and an expiry countdown, plus a corner teaser if it's dismissed.

items.name: category-carousel
items.title: Category Carousel
items.description: A shop-by-category row of round photo bubbles that scrolls, drags and snaps, with arrows, a scroll progress bar, New badges and a Sale bubble; picking a category slides a ring onto it and swaps in that category's products with quick add buttons.

items.name: featured-categories-banner
items.title: Featured Categories Banner
items.description: A banner of expanding category panels: the open one grows to show its photo, headline, tagline, product count and a Shop button while the others shrink to vertical labels, rotating on a timer with a progress line that pauses on hover; on phones it becomes a vertical accordion.

items.name: icon-category-nav
items.title: Icon Category Nav
items.description: A store category bar of line icons with labels that keeps as many categories as fit and folds the rest into a More menu as the width changes, with a little hover animation per icon, a sliding underline on the current category and a subcategory strip below.

items.name: tabbed-product-list
items.title: Tabbed Product List
items.description: A product grid with Best sellers, New arrivals, On sale and Top rated tabs: each tab sorts the products its own way and shows its own badge and detail line, cards reshuffle into place when you switch, with a hover quick add bar, a wishlist heart and Show more.

items.name: masonry-product-grid
items.title: Masonry Product Grid
items.description: A Pinterest-style product wall of mixed-height photos with a collection card, customer quotes and a shipping note woven in, category filters that reflow the columns with animation, a Cozy / Compact density switch, wishlist hearts and a hover bar to add to cart.

items.name: product-list-rows
items.title: Product List View (Rows)
items.description: A product list laid out as rows: photo, blurb, spec chips, stars and live stock, price with the old price, a quantity stepper and add to cart, wishlist hearts, expandable details, a compare checkbox that fills a tray, sorting and a comfortable / compact density switch.

items.name: mini-cart-dropdown
items.title: Mini Cart Dropdown
items.description: A store header with a cart icon that opens a dropdown cart: badge that bumps on add, free-shipping progress, line items with quantity steppers and remove with undo, subtotal, view cart and checkout; adding from the picks below opens it, highlights the new line and closes it again after a few seconds.

items.name: cart-modal
items.title: Cart Modal
items.description: A product with a size picker whose Add to cart opens a centered cart modal: an Added to your cart header, line items with quantity steppers, complete-the-set add-ons, a discount code field, totals and checkout, with focus trap, Escape and click-outside to close.

items.name: express-checkout-buttons
items.title: Express Checkout Buttons
items.description: An express checkout card with wallet, saved card, pay-in-4 and bank buttons above a continue-with-email field; each opens a payment sheet with the method's details (card, instalment plan or bank choice), shipping address and speed, the total and a confirm button that shows progress and success.

items.name: multi-step-checkout-block
items.title: Multi-step Checkout Block
items.description: A four-step checkout in one card: a stepper whose connectors fill as you go, contact and address with country-aware postcode checks, delivery options, card payment with brand detection and a Luhn check, a review with edit links, then a placing-order state and a success screen, next to an order summary with tax.

items.name: accordion-checkout
items.title: Accordion Checkout
items.description: A one-page checkout made of four accordion sections (contact, shipping address, delivery, payment) that open in turn, check their fields and fold into a one-line summary with edit, a segmented progress bar, a pay button that unlocks when everything is filled, and a sticky order summary with discount codes and tax.

items.name: order-confirmation-block
items.title: Order Confirmation Block
items.description: A thank-you section after checkout: springy check with confetti, a copyable order number, a tracking timeline with the current step pulsing, a live change-or-cancel window with an inline confirm, downloadable receipt and calendar file, items with buy again, address and payment, create-an-account and a copyable referral code.

items.name: horizontal-filter-bar
items.title: Horizontal Filter Bar
items.description: A sticky filter bar above a product grid: dropdown pills for category (with live counts), price range with presets, colour swatches and rating, one-tap On sale and In stock toggles, a sort menu, removable active-filter chips with clear all, and a grid that reflows with animation; scrolls sideways on phones.

items.name: mobile-filter-modal
items.title: Mobile Filter Modal
items.description: A phone-first filter sheet: a floating Filter & sort button with an active-count badge opens a bottom sheet you can drag down to close, with sort radios and collapsible category, price, colour, rating and in-stock sections that summarise their choice, plus a sticky footer with Clear and a live Show N results button.

items.name: gift-card-designer
items.title: Gift Card Designer
items.description: A gift card builder with a live 3D preview that tilts with the pointer and flips to show the message side: six card designs, preset or custom amounts with limits, to, from and recipient email, a 140-character message in three letterings, send now or on a date, and an add-to-cart button that confirms.

items.name: rating-summary-breakdown
items.title: Rating Summary Breakdown
items.description: A ratings summary that explains the score: big average with stars, an all-time / last 90 days switch, clickable 5-to-1 star bars, a would-recommend ring with verified share, a 12-month trend line, attribute scores, a two-ended scale, topic chips with positive and negative counts and matching review snippets.

items.name: photo-review-gallery
items.title: Photo Review Gallery
items.description: A customer photo wall for a product: a mosaic with a featured photo and quote, All / 5 stars / Verified filters, a +N tile, a lightbox with the photo, rating, review, verified badge, helpful vote, thumbnails, arrow keys and swipe, plus an Add your photos button that previews picked images.

items.name: write-a-review-form
items.title: Write a Review Form
items.description: A product review form with a hover-preview star rating, a fit scale, headline and review fields with a live character goal, quick tags, drag-and-drop photo previews, a recommend toggle, name and email with an initial-only option, a live preview card, inline validation and an animated thank-you screen.

items.name: sticky-add-to-cart-bar
items.title: Sticky Add to Cart Bar
items.description: A product page whose buy box hands off to a floating add-to-cart bar once the main button scrolls away: product thumb, live variant summary, an upward size menu, quantity, price and an Add to cart button that turns into Added while the cart count bumps.

items.name: size-guide-modal
items.title: Size Guide Modal
items.description: A shoe product card with a size grid and a Size guide link that opens a modal with three tabs: a selectable US/UK/EU size chart in cm or inches, a Find my size tool that recommends a size from foot length and width, and an illustrated How to measure guide. Picking a size applies it to the product.

items.name: frequently-bought-together
items.title: Frequently Bought Together
items.description: A bundle builder for product pages: the current product plus add-ons joined by plus signs, each toggled with a check, greyed out when skipped, with bundle discount tiers, a counting total, savings and an Add all to cart button that confirms the items added.

items.name: recently-viewed-products
items.title: Recently Viewed Products
items.description: A browsing history strip grouped into Today, Yesterday and This week: snap-scrolling product cards with viewed times, price drop, back in stock and low stock badges, a quick add button that expands to Added, per-item removal and Clear history with an undo toast, and an empty state.

items.name: wishlist-drawer
items.title: Wishlist Drawer
items.description: A product grid with heart buttons that burst when saved, a Wishlist pill with a springy count, and a slide-in drawer listing saved items with variant, sale savings and stock, Move to cart, Notify me for sold-out items, a Share link button, a price drop alert switch and Move all to cart.

items.name: back-in-stock-notify
items.title: Back-in-Stock Notify
items.description: A product buy box where picking a sold-out size swaps Add to cart for a restock alert: expected date and people waiting, an Email or Text message switch, validation, a half-size-either-side option and a ringing-bell confirmation, with alert badges on sizes and removable alert chips.

items.name: low-stock-urgency-badge
items.title: Low Stock Urgency Badge
items.description: Honest stock urgency for product pages and cards: badges that switch between In stock, Selling fast, Only n left (pulsing amber), Last one! (red with a shake) and Back on a date, plus a segmented stock meter that highlights the units you're about to take and drops when you add to cart.

items.name: shipping-estimator
items.title: Shipping Estimator
items.description: A shipping and delivery estimator: a free-shipping progress bar, country and postal code fields with per-country validation, delivery options (Standard, Express, Next day, store pickup) with prices and business-day ranges, remote-area surcharges and an animated timeline of real delivery dates for the chosen option.

items.name: product-comparison-table
items.title: Product Comparison Table
items.description: A side-by-side product comparison with a sticky header of photos, prices, ratings and Add to cart buttons, collapsible spec groups, yes/partly/no marks, bars and Best badges for measured specs, a Show differences only switch, column hover, removable and re-addable products, and a sticky first column when it scrolls sideways on phones.

items.name: aurora-area-chart
items.title: Aurora Area Chart
items.description: A calm multi-series area chart with monotone curves and soft fills, source toggles that show live values, a hover readout and keyboard point inspection.

items.name: cohort-retention-heatmap
items.title: Cohort Retention Heatmap
items.description: A single-hue cohort retention matrix with percentage and user views, weighted retention, hover details and unobserved periods kept apart from zero.

items.name: race-replay-line-chart
items.title: Race Replay Line Chart
items.description: A replayable multi-series line chart: press play and the lines race through the year, the leader drawn stronger, with live rankings, a scrubber and four speeds.
